statutes.title: Theft
statutes.description: Whoever intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to commit theft.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

statutes.title: Theft in Dwelling House or Building
statutes.description: Theft committed in any building, tent or vessel used as a human dwelling or for custody of property.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 7 years and fine.

statutes.title: Punishment for Murder
statutes.description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

statutes.title: Divorce Proceedings and Grounds
statutes.description: Grounds for dissolution of marriage by decree of divorce including cruelty, desertion, adultery, and mutual consent.

statutes.title: Punishment for Cruelty to Child
statutes.description: Whoever having the actual charge of or control over a child, assaults, abandons, abuses, exposes or wilfully neglects the child.

statutes.title: Voyeurism & Taking Photos Without Consent
statutes.description: Any person who captures, photographs, publishes or transmits the image of a person without consent in circumstances where privacy is expected or captures private acts without authorization.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment of 1 to 3 years and fine for first conviction; up to 7 years for subsequent conviction.

statutes.title: Punishment for Violation of Privacy
statutes.description: Intentionally or knowingly capturing, publishing, or transmitting the image of a private area of any person without consent, violating their privacy.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine up to Rs. 2 Lakhs, or both.

statutes.title: Stalking & Electronic Surveillance
statutes.description: Any person who follows, monitors, photographs, or contacts a person repeatedly despite clear indication of disinterest, or monitors someone electronically without consent.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 3 years and fine for first conviction.

statutes.title: Unlawful Personal Data & Biometric Image Capture
statutes.description: Processing or capturing personal data (including facial photograph or identity details) without valid notice and explicit consent of the data principal.
statutes.penalty: Penalty of up to Rs. 250 Crores imposed by Data Protection Board of India.

statutes.title: Fundamental Right to Personal Liberty and Privacy
statutes.description: Protection of Life and Personal Liberty. Extends to the Fundamental Right to Privacy as upheld by the Supreme Court of India in K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India.
statutes.penalty: Constitutional Remedy via Writ Petitions under Article 226 / 32.
